items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Harold West and I came to -- had an arrangement where he played some of my sets on one Sunday while I cooked, and I'd reciprocate and cover him on his sets the following Sunday while he cooked.

ctx.x: One incident of note -- I had an arrangement with Harold West, an excellent soul food cook -- that was his hobby, as well as mine. I have been cooking since I was a kid. I started actually cooking on the road because I loved my grandmother's food, and as a kid on the road, I missed that New England home cooking, so I had to cook it myself to remind me of home.

However, back to the Deuces -- Harold West and I came to -- had an arrangement where he played some of my sets on one Sunday while I cooked, and I'd reciprocate and cover him on his sets the following Sunday while he cooked.

They didn't serve food in the Deuces, because they couldn't afford a regular cook, a chef. So I had a beautiful kitchen all to myself for the first time in my life -- with huge ranges, 10, 15 and 20 gallon pots. Just shining, steel pots -- the works, and I was thrilled.
